text: I think I will be able to change universities!!! I still have to send some documents, but they accepted me. I won't know until August if I am really in. I am excited and a little nervous about it.
Just finished Part 5, Volume 11 of Ascendance of a Bookworm. Might start Volume 12 tonight.

Well, after a few intense weeks of weighing my options, I’ve decided to study at TecNM Virtual. These were my options: studying Web Systems Development at UDG, or Computer Systems Engineering at UVEG, UVM, etc. I really like the curriculum at TecNM; it covers the very things I want to study on my own. I don't feel comfortable studying the DOM, for example, without knowing graph theory; which is why I'm leaving UDG; nor do I feel comfortable studying cybersecurity without knowing networking. Studying at UVEG could be a good option too, I’d finish sooner, but I don't know; I just preferred TecNM's curriculum. I'll be taking linear algebra next semester, which is exactly the pace I want. However, it's a very new university, and I'm afraid of ending up being the only student in my cohort, or that I might spend four years on my degree only for something to happen that prevents me from getting my diploma. I don't know... my goal is to pursue a master's degree later on, so I'm pinning all my hopes on TecNM; I'm not turning back. So, I'm counting on you! If any TecNM Virtual administrator sees this, I want you to know that you have a student here who believes in you. Don't let me down, and I won't let you down, pleaseeeeee!!! (；人 ；)
